Title: Users' audio quality may be degraded during Microsoft Teams calls

User impact: Users' audio quality may be degraded during Microsoft Teams calls.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users' audio quality may be degraded during Microsoft Teams calls that have video or screensharing enabled

User impact: Users' audio quality may be degraded during Microsoft Teams calls that have video or screensharing enabled.

More info: Impact is specific to Microsoft Teams builds 26225.1806 and newer and may when users are on a call or meeting that uses video or screensharing. Users may be able to avoid degraded audio by disabling video or screenshare.

Current status: We've identified that a recent Microsoft Teams service update introduced an issue in which users' audio quality may be degraded. We're determining the most efficient method to reverse the update and remediate the impact. 

Scope of impact: Any user that's joined a Microsoft Teams meeting or call that has video or screensharing enabled may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A recent Microsoft Teams service update introduced an issue in which users' audio quality may be degraded.


Next update by: Saturday, October 3, 2026, at 12:30 AM UTC
